  • 看見《Ben 10》以更黑暗、寫實的方式重新詮釋經典故事。
  • 了解小班初次使用 Omnitrix 時，變身伴隨的痛苦與失控危機。
  • 回顧小班、小玟與馬克爺爺聯手對抗外星威脅的精彩過程。

摘要

Omnitrix 降臨，小班痛苦變身

作者介紹由原作團隊 Man of Action 參與製作的全新《Ben 10》漫畫。這個版本採取更成人、黑暗的風格，並強調變身並非輕鬆的超能力，而是伴隨劇烈疼痛的肉體變化。故事開端，反派魔賈斯在宇宙中追尋足以征服全宇宙的 Omnitrix；地球上，十歲的小班則與堂妹小玟、爺爺馬克展開暑假旅行。

小班與小玟爭吵後跑進森林，恰巧遇上載有 Omnitrix 的莢艙墜落。手錶如藤蔓般纏上他的手腕，無法取下。躲避軍方搜索時，小班遭遇機械合成熊，意外變身成四手霸王擊退敵人；之後又變成火焰人，引發森林大火。Omnitrix 隨後失控，迫使他的身體連續變成多種殘缺的外星形態，讓他痛苦不堪，最後昏厥過去。

螃蟹怪入侵，眾人合力迎戰

外星追兵螃蟹怪循著 Omnitrix 的訊號來到地球，並在追蹤過程中重創軍方。小班逃跑時變成能縮成球體滾動的轟天雷，小玟則開著老破車撞上他，兩人才得以會合。螃蟹怪闖入軍方營地大肆破壞，馬克也藉由老破車趕去支援。

在小玟鼓勵下，小班變身為鑽石戰神迎戰螃蟹怪，但變身時間耗盡後恢復原形，陷入危險。馬克以老破車的電磁脈衝干擾敵人，替小班爭取機會；小班再度變成四手霸王，終於擊倒螃蟹怪。軍方試圖抓捕小班時，馬克以煙霧彈掩護孩子們撤離。

新的威脅與漫畫特色

得知螃蟹怪戰敗後，魔賈斯決定親自前往地球。作者接著比較漫畫與動畫的差異，指出漫畫更著重變身的生理痛楚、外星威脅的壓迫感，以及恐怖寫實的氛圍，並預告後續篇章將有反派三波索登場。最後，作者邀請觀眾分享心得，並與大家道別。

item.itunes:summary:

值得閱讀的理由

  • 透過惡魔之城的荒誕冒險，呈現《探險活寶》一貫的幽默與奇想。
  • 故事不直接告訴觀眾何謂善惡，而是讓芬恩與傑克的不同看法引發思考。
  • 作者補充獨眼巨人、森林巨人等設定，也分享作品陪伴自己與孩子成長的感受。

摘要

荒唐冒險從傑克的髒話開始

作者介紹《探險活寶：菲歐娜與蛋糕》第一季第三集〈毀滅〉，並稱這集保留了原作的荒謬趣味，也帶有寓意。故事一開始，芬恩與傑克正和怪物交戰，傑克卻不慎踢到石頭，痛得脫口說出一連串髒話。這些話語竟化成巨大的惡魔，衝進城鎮縱火，兩人只好趕忙救火。

後院埋藏著九百多隻惡魔

回家後，芬恩追問傑克剛才的髒話，傑克才坦承多年前自己也曾因生氣而說出不該說的話，讓小惡魔從嘴裡冒出來。他沒有處理牠們，而是把惡魔裝進瓶子埋在後院；多年下來，數量已累積到九百二十九隻，後院甚至成了一座惡魔城市。芬恩認為這些惡魔危險又邪惡，堅持要挖出來處理，傑克則覺得牠們只是無心犯錯，未必會傷害任何人。

芬恩眼中的邪惡，未必真是邪惡

為了讓芬恩安心，傑克挖出瓶子、放出惡魔。芬恩一開始還會質問牠們是否邪惡，接著便因對方的挑釁或外表而動手；傑克也跟著清理惡魔。可是不久後，他們發現一些瓶子已經空了，惡魔似乎早已溜走。芬恩循著線索找到樹裡的隱藏空間，發現惡魔不但有自己的聚集地，還像普通居民一樣聊天、抱怨上司。

判斷善惡並不只看外表

芬恩仍認定惡魔的領袖和聚會肯定別有陰謀，傑克卻提醒他，眼前的情況可能只是平常的閒聊。接著，一隻看起來十分可怕的惡魔卡在門縫裡，請兩人幫忙脫困；傑克沒有伸出援手，反而拿牠的窘境開玩笑。這段情節延續了本集的核心趣味：外表和第一印象不一定能證明誰是好人或壞人。影片片段在此處中斷，故事後續尚未交代。

================================================

What time is adventure time? Hello everyone, I'm Daddy. The latest Adventure Time work, Adventure Time: Fionna and Cake, is officially out. For a long time, every Adventure Time work has offered not just exciting adventures , but also hidden meanings that leave you thinking. The seemingly humorous plots always manage to move and inspire us viewers at the critical moment. The new series, Fionna and Cake, is the same; even though the story is geared more toward children, the humorous style remains unchanged. The story doesn't tell you directly what is right or wrong, but lets you experience it yourself through the plot , understanding the underlying lessons from the adventure. Fionna and Cake is truly fantastic. Today, I want to introduce the third episode of the first season, "Destruction." Due to an unexpected event during an adventure, Jake says some words that shouldn't be said. These foul words create a bunch of demons, and Jake never deals with them, eventually leading them to build a demon city! How is 12-year-old Finn supposed to. handle these demons? Can he defeat them all? This episode fully captures the spirit of Adventure Time—funny, absurd, and educational—and has been rated by fans as the closest to the original series among the new Fionna and Cake episodes. Having grown up watching Adventure Time , I never imagined that one day it would also be growing up with my own child. So, without further ado, let's look at the story of the demon city Jake created ! Today's video is starting. If you want. to watch more of Daddy's Adventure Time commentary, feel free to click the info card. Don't forget to subscribe before we start so you don't miss any more of Daddy's videos. Adventure Time: Fionna and Cake, Season 1, Episode 3, " Destruction." At the start of the story , Finn and Jake are engaged in an exciting and fun battle. Jake is fighting against battle butterflies. These butterflies are ridiculous; they are invulnerable. Jake hacks at them with an axe, but they're fine. And what about Finn? He is battling a cyclops. This cyclops looks very similar to the one in Season 1, Episode 13, "City of.

Thieves." In the City of Thieves, everyone steals from each other. They steal things back and forth. He stole a flower basket, and then his glasses got stolen. Alright, I still don't understand why a cyclops would need to wear glasses. That’s true Adventure Time-style humor! Wow, there’s more than just this one cyclops in the secret files; there’s an Ice Cyclops in the Ice King's kingdom and a Forest Cyclops in the woods. The Forest Cyclops is incredibly powerful, and its magical tears can heal any wound, but it has a heart of stone and never cries. Finn punched him in the eye to make him cry, and since Finn was heavily injured , the tears completely healed him; the tears were on a sandwich, and the sandwich even had life. The Enchiridion has a full page introducing Forest Giants, and it's possible other cyclopes are included in the Enchiridion as well. But hey guys, Jake left the cyclops for Finn to handle, which means this battle butterfly might be even stronger than the cyclops! Bro, how did our fight even start? It's a bit complicated; this fire-breathing cyclops stole the purse belonging to the. lady in the power-panties. Then the wizard turned the purse into a pineapple , the butterfly stole the pineapple— it's a super complex sequence, exactly the kind of thing that happens in the City of Thieves. Right, I forgot, I was too busy listening to Finn that Jake wasn't even watching where he was going and accidentally kicked a rock. Unable to stand the pain, Jake started swearing , blurting out a whole bunch of dirty words. The Mandarin dub is a bit subtle , but it's also very funny. The voice actor for Uncle Lu-Dan uses lines like " Big and old as hell,""Damn it,""What the heck," and "What the hell are you doing. ?""What the hell" is honestly my favorite; many Taiwanese people don't want to curse too harshly, so they say " what the hell," and back in elementary school, we would always say the word " hell" really loudly. As for the original English, wow, it's pretty filthy. Jake uses special English words to replace the swears; although the words are different, the pronunciation is almost identical to the F-word, and even Jake’s signature curses are thrown in. It’s really not easy to hear the F-word in a children's cartoon, but Jake’s swearing......created a giant demon.

because the language was just so foul. This demon was massive, making everyone who heard it incredibly embarrassed; Finn’s face was super red, super, super red, and even the giant, the wizard lady , and the butterfly couldn't stand the swearing and quickly ran away. Whoa, look at that lady using her power-panties to fly away at full speed , that's hilarious. The giant demon is born and charges straight into a nearby town, setting it ablaze; no time to be embarrassed, Jake and Finn rush to help put out the fire. Then, Jake gets back to his "toodle-loo. ," and he’s so bad, singing and happily walking home. Adventure ends, heading home happy, cooking for Finn, then washing up and going to sleep for the night. Jake’s song seems like an attempt to cover up all those nasty things he said, but what happened, happened. Finn heard it, how could he just forget it? I did, I heard it, I heard you swearing ! "Alright, alright brother, you're really hung up on me saying a swear word earlier, huh? I didn't know I wasn't allowed to do that." No, it's more serious than that, you created a giant demon! 摘要

荒唐冒險從傑克的髒話開始

作者介紹《探險活寶：菲歐娜與蛋糕》第一季第三集〈毀滅〉，並稱這集保留了原作的荒謬趣味，也帶有寓意。故事一開始，芬恩與傑克正和怪物交戰，傑克卻不慎踢到石頭，痛得脫口說出一連串髒話。這些話語竟化成巨大的惡魔，衝進城鎮縱火，兩人只好趕忙救火。

後院埋藏著九百多隻惡魔

回家後，芬恩追問傑克剛才的髒話，傑克才坦承多年前自己也曾因生氣而說出不該說的話，讓小惡魔從嘴裡冒出來。他沒有處理牠們，而是把惡魔裝進瓶子埋在後院；多年下來，數量已累積到九百二十九隻，後院甚至成了一座惡魔城市。芬恩認為這些惡魔危險又邪惡，堅持要挖出來處理，傑克則覺得牠們只是無心犯錯，未必會傷害任何人。

芬恩眼中的邪惡，未必真是邪惡

為了讓芬恩安心，傑克挖出瓶子、放出惡魔。芬恩一開始還會質問牠們是否邪惡，接著便因對方的挑釁或外表而動手；傑克也跟著清理惡魔。可是不久後，他們發現一些瓶子已經空了，惡魔似乎早已溜走。芬恩循著線索找到樹裡的隱藏空間，發現惡魔不但有自己的聚集地，還像普通居民一樣聊天、抱怨上司。

判斷善惡並不只看外表

芬恩仍認定惡魔的領袖和聚會肯定別有陰謀，傑克卻提醒他，眼前的情況可能只是平常的閒聊。接著，一隻看起來十分可怕的惡魔卡在門縫裡，請兩人幫忙脫困；傑克沒有伸出援手，反而拿牠的窘境開玩笑。這段情節延續了本集的核心趣味：外表和第一印象不一定能證明誰是好人或壞人。影片片段在此處中斷，故事後續尚未交代。
